sourceRefs.locator: Gregory IX.42; Epistolae 914, first paragraphs and final appeal: Chlothar’s resources, Agnes’s election, obedience of the founder, protection of property, and burial in the church dedicated to Mary even if unfinished.
ER 1931, Gregory IX.40, text and Discussion: the clerics’ mission probably in 568, Eufronius of Tours, and the reception in Poitiers in 569.
Attestation 933, Gregory, Glory of the Confessors 104: he went to Radegund’s community at Poitiers on hearing of her death.
X.16, pp. 123–126: complaints, Leubovera’s answers, Didimia confirming her gift to the abbess and the judges’ reasons for retaining her.
Q6616, P625, the orientation coordinates already used in the chapter on Visigothic Poitiers.

processingNote.de: Die Berichte nennen Poitiers und mehrere kirchliche Orte. Der Umriss bezeichnet das nähere Stadtgebiet. Lage und Größe der Klosteranlage sowie der Prozessionsweg sind daraus nicht abzulesen.
processingNote.en: The accounts name Poitiers and several church sites. The outline indicates the city locality. It does not reconstruct the convent plan, its extent or the processional route.
